name: base
description: The criteria every run owes, regardless of what it is testing. A task checklist declares `"extends": "_base"` and then adds only what is task-specific. These were being re-typed into every checklist, which is how one of them quietly goes missing from the file where it mattered — and it made each checklist read as bespoke when most of it never is. Override any of these by reusing its id: the task always wins.

items.claim: No uncaught exceptions or unhandled rejections during the run
items.falsifiedBy: any page error. This is the channel agent-browser's own `errors` cannot see — it comes from the injected hook, and it is the single highest-value signal the tape is blind to

items.claim: No console errors during the run
items.falsifiedBy: any console error. Weigh it rather than reflex-failing: plenty of pages log errors that do not matter. The point is that you decide KNOWING

any 4xx/5xx or status-0 request. Incomplete requests are reported separately and are NOT failures — one still in flight at the last sample is normal. If your flow EXPECTS a failure status, override this id with a `matching` filter that excludes it

items.claim: The run reached its end rather than dying partway
items.falsifiedBy: no `record-stop` chapter — the flow threw, so every item after the failure point is unreached rather than judged
